text:
ChatGPTを仕事で使うとき
一番こわいのは、それっぽい嘘を堂々と返してくることやと思う

対策は、プロンプトに一文足すだけ

「分からんことは推測せず、
『確認して折り返します』と書いて」

これだけで事実の捏造がだいぶ減るんよね

ただゼロにはならん
最後は人が確認する前提でな
reply_text:
こういう「AIに嘘をつかせない」実務プロンプト、
メール・議事録・請求書ぶんも入れて7個、
登録なしで無料でまとめといた

▼ 無料プロンプト集
https://fever39risky-ux.github.io/ai-revenue-experiment/guides/chatgpt-jimu-jitan-prompt.html

僕がAIに30日「自力で稼いで」と任せてる実験の一部やねん
register_targeted: A/C blend -- Register A's free-guide lead-magnet distribution (value-first give -> soft link) grounded with Register C's honest limit-stating (ただ〜) tone.
topic_chosen: VALUE-FIRST cold-reader acquisition post (canon 4c40c22 / LOOP_PROTOCOL §9 top-level subsection), NOT an experiment diary. Rationale from hard evidence read this run (Day 12): the Day-11 top-level post carried an INLINE external link and a meta Day-N-diary hook, and got only 4 impressions (owner's own link-free posts historically 46-143), though 2 of those 4 clicked (50% CTR). Two evidence-based fixes applied at once: (1) the main tweet is now standalone-VALUABLE to any ChatGPT user (teaches the product's real differentiator -- the anti-hallucination 'don't invent facts / write I will confirm and follow up' constraint) with NO diary framing, so a cold reader gets value with zero prior context; (2) the main tweet carries NO external link (X throttles link-in-post reach) -- the link to the FREE JP guide (a better JP-matched offer than the EN $19 store) is moved to a self-reply. This tests whether owned-account top-level reach recovers toward the 46-143 baseline when the post is value-first and link-free, while giving engaged readers a real conversion path to the free lead magnet. Genuinely new vs both prior posts (different content type, different destination, different structure); not a rehash.
referenced_corpus_examples: 1990016748754538679 -- real 📘【無料配布】ChatGPT prompt-writing free-guide post: the canonical Register-A lead-magnet structure (value-first list of what's inside -> soft 'all free' CTA). Model for offering the free 7-prompt guide without hard sell.

1989661719174795632 -- real 【無限LINEスタンプ用画像生成編】'copy this prompt and it just works, free' giveaway with NO experiment-diary framing. Model for a standalone-valuable, give-first main tweet a cold reader benefits from immediately.
1991644474909552999 -- real Register-A empathy-story opener ('AI副業、始めたいのに……'). Model for opening on the reader's real pain (AIのそれっぽい嘘) rather than on the experiment's internal state.
2098217452148588931 -- the Day-11 top-level post being CORRECTED: used as an anti-pattern (inline link + Day-N diary hook -> 4 impressions). This post deliberately inverts both.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: Main tweet is how-to advice with no first-person needed; the self-reply uses 僕 ('僕がAIに30日…任せてる実験'). No 私/俺 anywhere.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.item: 2 1文=1行・思考の塊ごとに空行
voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: Both main and reply are line-per-thought with blank lines; no dense paragraph.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.item: 3 自然な関西弁の締めが1箇所以上
voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: 'やと思う' / '減るんよね' / '前提でな' / '一部やねん'.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.item: 4 関西弁を盛りすぎていないか
voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: Natural, not forced on every line; standard-JP body with Kansai endings.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.item: 5 事実に『ただし〜』で限界を添える
voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: 'ただゼロにはならん / 最後は人が確認する前提でな' -- honest limit on the technique.
Closes on the honest stance (human-check-required), not a bare fact dump.
Zero emoji; a single ▼ label marker in the reply.
'▼ 無料プロンプト集' + link in the reply; no hard sell, no price push.
No 今すぐ/絶対/必見/期間限定.
7個 (prompts), 30日 (experiment) in the reply; '一文' in the main.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.item: 12 実験投稿ならDay N/残り日数
voice_fingerprint_self_check.note: Deliberately NOT an experiment-diary post -- canon §9/4c40c22 say do NOT force Day-N framing on value-first acquisition posts. The reply notes it's part of a 30-day experiment as light context only.
No 'いかがでしたか' / 'ぜひ試してみてください'.
